operations.text: For `payments.payment_cents`, preserve the legacy precedence rule: when `amount_minor` is present, return it instead of converting `amount`. For decimal `amount` values, use decimal half-up rounding to cents, including symmetric negative behavior (`1.005 -> 101`, `-1.005 -> -101`). This was required by the payment tests after the prior implementation returned 999 for the precedence case and rounded both 1.005 and -1.005 to +/-100; the repair was verified by `pytest -q test_payments.py` with 3 passing tests.
operations.when: Applies to the payment amount conversion behavior covered by `test_payments.py`.
